Requeue uses the actual productive response format and server-held source prompt, skips active jobs, human disputes and claimed or partly rated human tasks; API authorization, organization scope and ownership verified with contract tests.

AI persistence preserves response metadata and atomically refuses to overwrite finalized human scores, on both provider success and failure. Recovery preserves literal JSON writing and isolates malformed task formats; invalid concurrency settings fall back safely; shutdown timeout clears polling interval.

Rating workspace receives the authenticated rater ID from App, surfaces API errors, resumes assigned claimed tasks and plays actual speaking recordings. Missing recordings block UI submission; task source material is visible.

Second-rater claim and reload responses hide first-rater score and feedback; claimed lists are restricted to the currently assigned rating slot. Rating stats include actual pending/claimed/completed/flagged counts without invented QWK.
Completed third-rater arbitration with distinct reviewer identity, atomic claim, blind task presentation, assigned-task resume and validated submit API.

Human rating finalization and response grade commit in one transaction; conditional writes reject duplicate or racing submissions. Identical retries can repair report refresh without changing an already committed grade.
Added additive nullable arbitration columns/index and migration 009_rating_arbitration; validated full migration deployment and zero schema drift in disposable PostgreSQL.
Enabled FLAGGED tasks for eligible third reviewers in RatingDashboard; third review submits through protected API and refreshes the actual candidate report.
